name: Al-Bayyinah · البينة
ar: جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدۡنٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ رَّضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُۥ
en: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord

name: Az-Zalzalah · الزلزلة
en: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake

name: Az-Zalzalah · الزلزلة
en: And the earth discharges its burdens

name: Az-Zalzalah · الزلزلة
en: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it

name: Az-Zalzalah · الزلزلة
en: That Day, it will report its news

name: Az-Zalzalah · الزلزلة
en: Because your Lord has commanded it

name: Az-Zalzalah · الزلزلة
ar: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
en: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds

name: Az-Zalzalah · الزلزلة
ar: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
en: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it

name: Az-Zalzalah · الزلزلة
ar: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
en: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it

name: Al-'Adiyat · العاديات
en: And the producers of sparks [when] striking

name: Al-'Adiyat · العاديات
en: Arriving thereby in the center collectively

name: Al-'Adiyat · العاديات
en: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful

name: Al-'Adiyat · العاديات
en: And indeed, he is to that a witness

name: Al-'Adiyat · العاديات
en: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense

name: Al-'Adiyat · العاديات
ar: ۞أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
en: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
